jobs.title: Oncology Strategy Director
jobs.description:
Career Category
Strategy and Innovation
Job Description
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

ONCOLOGY STRATEGY DIRECTOR

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you will lead strategic initiatives that shape Amgen’s Oncology Therapeutic Area future, with a focus on topics in the R&D space. While the role can be located remotely there is an expectation that availability at times of high activity may need to accommodate some Pacific Time Zone working hours.
- Lead and manage strategic, cross-functional projects commissioned by Development leadership.
- Independently drive project execution and influence stakeholders across multiple functions and levels.
- Develop and support annual therapeutic area strategies, including oncology portfolio planning.
- Conduct technology assessments, deep-dive analyses, and landscape evaluations.
- Perform cross-portfolio analytics, risk assessments, and strategic decision-support activities.
- Support scientific collaborations with external academic partners through the Amgen Partners of Choice program.
- Facilitate scientific exchange and coordinate partnership-related projects.
- Manage global external communications and represent the organization with key external stakeholders.
- Serve as a trusted advisor and representative for Development leadership.
- Navigate ambiguity and lead ad hoc strategic initiatives and special projects as business needs arise.

What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a leader with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:
Doctorate degree and 4 years of healthcare business experience
Or
Master’s degree and 7 years of healthcare business experience
Or
Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of healthcare business experience

Preferred Qualifications:

- MD, MBA, MS, Ph.D. or equivalent
- Eight (8) or more years of strategy experience within management consulting, finance, or corporate strategy functions
- Robust knowledge of biopharma industry (i.e., pharma development, translational sciences, R&D processes)
- Understanding of interplay among various stakeholders in the industry, awareness of trends and recent developments, and ability to research / learn/ synthesize findings on new topics
- Oncology R&D experience in the biopharmaceutical industry (biotech, pharmaceutical company)
- Excellent cross-functional communication skills and a decisive yet affiliative leadership style to drive results while maintaining relationships
- Strong presence with Senior Executives including ability to communicate effectively on a prepared and ad-hoc basis
- Proven experience as a member and leader of a high performing team

What you can expect of us
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

- Drive performance-management processes, including business reporting, insights, and action planning to enable timely decisions and course correction.
- Facilitate Marketing–Sales integration, ensuring alignment between brand strategy, field execution, customer insights, and commercial priorities.
- Develop key presentations, reports, and communications for governance meetings, leadership forums, and planning sessions.

- Drive adoption of AI tools and capabilities to enhance business efficiency, analytics, and decision-making.

- Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of project management experience; AND

Job Description
What you will do
In this role, you will operate as a core member of the Results Delivery Office (RDO) capability engine, responsible for building, scaling, and driving adoption of the systems, tools, and operating processes that enable enterprise transformation at Amgen.
Reporting to the Associate Director, you will act as a business owner of defined RDO capabilities—spanning change management frameworks, digital platforms, and AI-enabled solutions. You will work in close partnership with technology and product teams to translate transformation needs into scalable solutions and ensure they deliver measurable business impact.
This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, transformation execution, and technology, requiring strong product thinking, operational discipline, and stakeholder influence.

Roles and Responsibilities:
- Own specific components of the RDO capability stack, translating enterprise transformation priorities into scalable tools, frameworks, and execution standards

- Ensure capabilities are embedded effectively across global programs, driving consistency and quality of execution

- Act as the business-facing product partner for digital change and AI-enabled solutions

- Act as a key contributor for the knowledge management build/run efforts for Results Delivery Office

- Define business requirements for change tools, including use cases, and success metrics; partner with technology teams on design, build, and release

- Drive adoption strategy, user engagement, and continuous improvement based on feedback and usage data

- Define and track KPIs across adoption, usage, execution quality, and business outcomes

- Develop reporting and insights to assess effectiveness of transformation capabilities

- Identify systemic friction points and lead interventions to improve speed, quality, and impact

- Partner with global transformation and program teams to deploy RDO tools and ways of working

- Act as a connector across business, technology, and execution teams to drive alignment

- Drive experimentation and innovation to improve user experience and execution productivity

What we expect of you
- Experience in transformation, strategy, operational excellence, or consulting environments

- Strong comfort working at the intersection of business and technology; able to partner effectively with product and engineering teams

- Experience with digital platforms, analytics, or workflow tools; exposure to AI/LLM use cases preferred

- Structured problem solver with strong analytical and data interpretation skills

- Ability to influence in a global, matrixed environment without direct authority

- Strong ownership mindset with accountability for outcomes and impact

Basic Qualifications:
Master’s or Bachelor's degree and 8 to 13 years of Business Performance, Continuous Improvement, or Project Management experience

Preferred Experience:
- Exposure to digital platforms, product operating models, or workflow tools

- Experience working with or deploying AI/LLM-enabled solutions in business contexts

- Background in consulting, transformation, or internal strategy functions

- Experience operating in global, matrixed environments

Ways of Working:
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

- Ability to partner closely with technology teams to deliver scalable solutions (without being a developer)

- Structured thinking and problem-solving

- Ability to operate with autonomy and drive outcomes in ambiguous environments

jobs.description:
Career Category
Regulatory
Job Description
HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?
Amgen is a global leader in biotechnology with a history of more than four decades of pioneering breakthroughs. Our commitment to science has led us to discover and develop innovative therapies that significantly improve patients' lives. We also invest in cutting-edge manufacturing and support services to deliver these therapies worldwide. Japan and the Asia Pacific (JAPAC) region represent the fastest-growing area for Amgen. We are currently seeking a qualified candidate for the role of Japan Regulatory Strategy Manager (Regulatory Affairs Mgr) in Tokyo, Japan.

Live
What you will do:
Japan Regulatory Affairs provides leadership, expertise, and execution for the regulatory strategy to obtain and maintain clinical trial and marketing licenses for Amgen molecules in Japan in alignment with local business priorities and global regulatory strategy.

Main Responsibilities
- The Japan Regulatory Strategy Mgr is developing and executing the regulatory strategies and plans; providing strategic regulatory expertise for drug development; interfacing with regulatory authorities; aligning with key cross-functional partners; integrating into Amgen’s commercialization process; and continuously improving business processes.

- The Japan Regulatory Strategy Mgr may be assigned to multiple Amgen products for product-specific activities.

- The Japan Regulatory Strategy Mgr has high level English language skills, deep SME Japan regulatory requirements and strong interpersonal skills with ability to influence and engage.

- Work closely with Global Regulatory Lead to integrate Japan regulator strategy into Global regulatory strategy.

Key Activities
Strategy and Execution
- Develops and implements the Japan regulatory strategy, aligned with global regulatory strategy as much as possible.

- Provides guidance on local mechanisms to accelerate/optimize product development and regulatory approvals.

- Proactively influence developing the global regulatory strategy so that Japan developments are aligned.

- Consistently look for opportunities to accelerate the developments/approval and/or increase the value of the program to serve for more patients.

- As a representative of the Japan Regulatory Strategy Group, contributes to the filing plan by advising and discussing with the local and global cross-functional teams.

- Leads the preparation of regulatory submissions, which may include New Drug Applications (NDAs), briefing documents for various types of PMDA consultations, Clinical Trial Notifications (CTNs), and Orphan Drug Applications in Japan according to the filing plan.

- Ensures that regulatory submissions are made on time and meet Amgen’s corporate and local regulatory requirements.

- Collaborates with Clinical Study Operations teams to support local planning and execution for clinical studies in accordance with national legal and regulatory requirements.

- Ensures that local labels are developed and maintained in line with local regulations and Amgen standards and procedures.

- Proactively lead to develop regulatory strategies and/or mitigate regulatory risks across RA Japan and/or across Amgen

- Lead process standardization/simplification to improve efficiency in regulatory processes

- Consistently demonstrate Amgen leadership behaviors

- Influence developing global regulatory strategies so that Japan development strategies are aligned.

- Increase visibility of RA Japan.

- Provide strong supports to the Japan Regulatory Strategy Group Head.

Communication and Collaboration
- Works cross-functionally with the various Amgen teams related to NDAs, PMDA consultations and CTNs, etc.

- Communicates clearly and in a timely manner with key stakeholders across the business.

- Provides subject matter expert support for local, regional, and global initiatives.

Health Authority (HA) Interaction
- Acts as the primary interface with MHLW and PMDA for product approval and clinical development.

- Leads and contributes to strategy for HA interactions.

- Attends HA meetings.

- Develops and maintain a good relationship with HAs in Japan to facilitate drug approvals.

External Interactions
- Engages with local trade associations to shape the external environment, monitors national legislation, and provides feedback to global and local colleagues in a timely manner.

Compliance
- Maintains regulatory compliance for all documents submitted to HA and post-approval commitments.

- Supports the monitoring, auditing, and self-assessment activities under the compliance framework.

- Contributes to the development and implementation of country-specific compliance procedures and working practices.

Win
What we expect of you:

Qualifications

Basic
- Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years of directly related experience including 5+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs

Preferred
- Advanced degree preferred

- In-depth regulatory experience

- Knowledge of Japan legislation and regulations relating to medicinal products

- Knowledge of drug development Scientific/Technical Excellence

- Teamwork

- Communication skills both oral and written

- Ability to understand and communicate scientific/clinical information

Knowledge and Skills
- Ability to lead effective teams

- Ability to work in matrix environments including cross-functional and global teams

- Ability to work under minimal direction with a medium degree of autonomy

- Analytical skills to evaluate and interpret complex situations and problems

- Ability to anticipate and prevent potential problems.

- Ability to independently develop solutions that are thorough, practical, and consistent with functional objectives

- Understanding of regulatory activities and how they affect projects and processes

- Ability to understand and communicate scientific and clinical information

- Organizational, communication, and time management skills needed to manage multiple assignments and processes

- Communication skills in English (TOEIC score ≥860 desirable)

- Native level Japanese

- Computers: Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Power Point, and communication tools

Job Description
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Manager, Strategic Planning & Operations, Digital Product Management
What you will do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will serve as a strategic partner to the VP Digital Product Management and senior leaders, translating Digital Product Management strategy into measurable priorities, operating plans, and outcomes. You will facilitate strategic planning, organizational effectiveness, technology and AI-enabled initiatives, business operations, and executive communications across the AI & Data organization.
This role combines strategic thinking, operational leadership, and organizational influence to accelerate delivery of transformative technology across the company.

Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership & Planning
- Deliver strategic and operational support to the VP and senior leadership team, ensuring the effective execution of business strategies, initiatives, policies, and procedures that drive departmental success.
- Translate strategic priorities into measurable goals, action plans, milestones, KPIs, and accountability frameworks that improve decision-making and execution across the function.
- Serve as a trusted advisor and thought partner on portfolio, organizational, capability, and investment decisions.
- Shape and run annual operating rhythms (LT offsites, staff meetings, and readouts).

Chief of Staff
- Manage day-to-day execution of departmental strategy, supporting cross-functional priorities, key decisions, and follow-through.
- Own agenda planning, coordination, and facilitation for leadership meetings and offsites.
- Serve as the connective tissue across AI&D leaders, tracking key initiatives and ensuring alignment.

Enhancing organizational effectiveness and culture

•  Drive leadership team effectiveness, operating cadence, and cross-functional alignment across the Digital Product Management organization.
•  Lead high-priority special projects involving organizational design, talent strategy, capability building, change management, and operational improvement.
•  Contribute to a strong culture by supporting offsites, seminar series, training, staff profiles, mentoring connections, and other engagement mechanisms.
•  Establish practical processes, tools, and ways of working that improve transparency, accountability, learning, and execution.

Lead business operations and executive communications
•  Coordinate budgeting, resource planning, headcount management, and scenario analyses in partnership with Finance, HR, Research Operations, and TA leadership.
•  Coordinate talent management processes, including hiring, promotions, workforce planning, and related personnel actions.
•  Develop executive-level presentations, business reviews, strategic communications, governance materials, portfolio reviews, and leadership updates.
•  Lead departmental communications strategy and content calendar, including newsletters, events, and executive updates.

- Doctorate degree and 2+ years of strategic planning, business operations, or consulting experience
OR

- Expertise with executive-level presentation, change management, and cross-functional planning
- High EQ and comfort navigating ambiguity with diplomacy and influence

jobs.title: Senior Associate - Strategic Planning & Operations
jobs.description:
Career Category
Clinical Development
Job Description
Job Description
Increasing demand for observational research (now commonly referred to as real-world evidence [RWE]) from regulatory and reimbursement authorities makes observational research a key component of drug development and commercialization. Amgen's Center for Observational Research (CfOR) is a global organization with an industry-leading analytical capability that generates RWE to support business needs across a product’s lifecycle. CfOR scientists partner with internal stakeholders and industry experts to design, conduct, interpret and publish observational research that informs decision-making from the early development of a molecule to the design of clinical trials and the safety and efficacy of Amgen medicines.
We are seeking a  Senior Associate, Strategic Planning & Operations , to join the Center for Observational Research (CfOR). This role will work with other Amgen functional teams to oversee and drive execution of CfOR’s operational projects and non-interventional studies ensuring timely completion within budget and at the highest quality with compliance. This role requires strong project management capabilities combined with a growth mindset and openness to leveraging emerging AI tools to improve productivity and drive CfOR-wide initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
- Support  end-to-end operational workflows/ automate tools  and standardise process maps / SOPs to improve efficiency in CfOR operational process such as  budget management, contracting,   dashboard management  and  project management /  PMO office.

- Driving  AI-enabled operational transformation  to enhance efficiency in compliance process, budget tracking, and decision-making across global CfOR programs

- Project management  including project planning, governance tracking, milestone management, Vendor onboarding, risk/issue tracking, and stakeholder reporting

- SharePoint management  experience in content governance to enable effective collaboration and efficient document control.

- Knowledge management/ training capabilities  - Design, track knowledge-sharing metrics and drive team engagement with continuous learning frameworks.

Operational Excellence & Process Optimization:
- Automate / standardize end-to-end workflows  & process maps to improve efficiency in CFOR operational process

- Drive execution of operational processes by monitoring budgets, contracts, study milestones, risks, and performance metrics while ensuring data accuracy, timely reporting, and adherence to regulatory, compliance and organizational requirements.

- Ensure quality, compliance, and alignment with global operational standards

- Strong experience in SharePoint management, including site administration, document libraries, permission management, and content governance to enable secure collaboration and efficient document control

AI & Digital Enablement:
-   Applied generative AI tools to improve productivity in documentation and operations

- Identify automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and standardize workflows

- Creating dashboards of operational processes

- Drove adoption and migration of digital tools (Smartsheet, MS tools, Teams, SharePoint, Miro, lucid) for collaboration and tracking

- Develop apps/ AI chatbots / migrate available processes to new technology/ tools based on organizational requirements

Project Management Office

- Demonstrated experience in PMO practices, including project planning, governance tracking, milestone management, stakeholder reporting, ensuring timely delivery, quality, and alignment with business priorities.

- Ability to apply Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid project management methodologies to improve execution, collaboration, and operational efficiency and improve project visibility and execution tracking.

Data, Reporting & Dashboarding:
- Developed and maintained operational dashboards and reports (Power BI/Excel/Smartsheet) to track study performance, resource utilization, and key KPIs

- Delivered actionable insights through data analysis and reporting to support leadership decision-making

Financial & Resource Management:
- Managed financial operations including PO processing, invoice verification, and expense tracking using SAP/Ariba/Anaplan

- Supported budget planning and resource management across programs

Basic Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of Clinical / Scientific Operations experience OR

- Master’s degree and 5+ years of Scientific or Operations experience

- Pharma/ Healthcare degree with application of  technology/ AI knowledge  expertise, advanced excel knowledge, dashboard creation for reporting, and decision support.

Preferred Qualifications/Skills:

- Minimum of 6 years of  project management  experience,  Agile Scrum master, with +4 years in pharma/biotech and cross-functional environments. Project planning & milestone tracking, process standardization & optimization, KPI design & reporting, cross-functional stakeholder management

- Technical: SQL, Python (incl. applied ML/predictive modeling), Tableau, Power BI & Analytics, Advanced Excel, Dashboard Creation & Reporting

- Hands-on experience with  budgeting ,  contracting,   PMO office , and working in regulated document management systems

- Drive  AI-enabled operational transformation  to enhance efficiency in CFoR operational process

- Demonstrated proficiency & adaptability with related software tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Smartsheet, Miro, SharePoint, MS Teams, Office 365, etc.)

- Quick learner with strong analytical skills and adaptability to new tools and concepts

- Demonstrates autonomy and reliability in managing tasks and contributing to team goals

- Highly organized, with the ability to prioritize and deliver on projects independently or collaboratively

- Effective communicator with strong written, verbal, and presentation abilities

- Builds positive relationships and fosters collaboration with a proactive, “can-do” attitude

- Familiarity with drug commercialization & business practices

.

Job Description

The Global Customer Capabilities & Innovation (GCCI) team is looking for an experienced Senior Associate, Web Strategy & Operations (WSO). GCCI delivers efficient and consistent quality global marketing assets that scale across multiple channels & markets. As part of GCCI, the Senior Associate provides integrated end-to-end program and project management to ensure successful delivery of websites and bring thought leadership and drive delivery.

Key Responsibilities:
- Strategic Web Project Lead:  Support the coordination and execution of cross-functional web projects across GCCI WSO, helping to ensure alignment on timelines, resources, and budgets for website enhancements and optimization initiatives. Partner with program leads to track progress, maintain alignment across initiatives, and identify potential risks, escalating as needed.
- Portfolio Prioritization & Planning: Support quarterly portfolio intake and prioritization across web initiatives in partnership with Technology and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment to enterprise strategy and value realization goals. Operationalize governance frameworks to evaluate demand, clarify requirements at a project level, assess cross-project dependencies, and align on delivery.
- Cross-Functional Coordination: Assist in alignment and day-to-day coordination across cross-functional teams, including content, design, development, SEO, analytics, project owners, and platform stakeholders, to enable effective planning and execution of web initiatives.
- Program Governance & Risk Management: Oversee project health across initiatives by monitoring delivery progress, governance adherence, documentation standards, cross-project risks, issues, and change impacts throughout launch and hypercare.
- Website Performance & Analytics: Support the tracking and reporting of KPIs by analyzing web traffic, user behavior, and SEO metrics. Contribute insights to help improve site performance and inform operational reviews.
- Quality Assurance & Testing: Conduct functional testing and ensure adherence to agile web development processes, industry best practices, and high-quality standards.
- Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence: Support retrospectives, identifying improvement opportunities. Support the adoption of governance frameworks, templates, and delivery processes to improve efficiency and speed-to-market.
- Capability Enablement & Portfolio Optimization: Continuously assess and optimize the web portfolio to ensure alignment with evolving business priorities, resource capacity, and long-term digital strategy.
- Compliance, Risk & Operational Resilience: Ensure compliance with regulatory, legal, and brand standards across all web initiatives. Embed risk management into project governance to support sustainable digital operations.
- Web Operations :   Support regional leads with the execution of operational activities to develop and maintain compliant websites such as access management, platform configuration, and risk assessments.

WHAT WE EXPECT OF YOU
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Web Project Manager professional we seek is a collaborator with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:
Doctorate degree
Or
Master’s degree and 2 years of digital or web project management experience
Or
Bachelor’s degree and 4 years of digital or web project management experience
Or
Associate’s degree and 10 years of digital or web project management experience
Or
High school diploma / GED and 12 years of digital or web project management experience

Preferred Experience:
- Digital Program / Project Management Expertise:
Over all we are looking for 5-9 years of experience and 3+ years of experience managing end-to-end digital and website lifecycle projects in fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environments, including complex, cross-country, and high-impact initiatives.
- Agile & Program Management:
Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies (preferably SAFe) with experience managing website roadmaps and continuous improvement initiatives. Proficient in Program / Project Management tools such as JIRA, ServiceNow, Confluence, and Google Analytics.
- Stakeholder & Vendor Management:
Proven ability to negotiate priorities, manage expectations, and build productive relationships across diverse, cross-functional teams and external partners.
- Regulatory & Technical Acumen:
Experience operating in regulated industries (preferably pharma) with understanding of compliance requirements. Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG), privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA), web technologies (e.g. HTML, CSS), and industry best practices is a plus.
- Documentation & Governance:
Experience developing detailed project documentation and translating business requirements into technical specifications.

Preferred Competencies:
- Customer Relationship & Collaboration:
Effective communication, relationship management, and cross-functional collaboration skills; able to convey complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
- Analytical & Digital Expertise:
Proficiency in web analytics, SEO, and UX/UI principles, with the ability to interpret data and drive actionable insights using digital marketing tools.
- Problem-Solving & Quality Focus:
Advanced problem-solving capabilities, attention to detail, and commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes while incorporating feedback.
- Adaptability & Growth Mindset:
Proactive, inclusive, and flexible approach with a willingness to learn, experiment, and continuously improve. Comfortable working across time zones when required.

THRIVE
WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT OF US
Vast opportunities to gain experience, develop, and move up and across our global organization.
A diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where colleagues are empowered to bring ideas to the table, try new things, and act.
Generous Amgen Total Rewards Plan comprising healthcare, finance, wealth, and career benefits.
Flexible work arrangements.
Equal opportunity statement
Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
Join Us
If you are seeking a career where you can truly make a difference in the lives of others, a career where you can work at the absolute forefront of biotechnology with the top minds in the field, you will find it at Amgen.
Amgen, a biotechnology pioneer, discovers, develops, and delivers innovative human therapeutics. Our medicines have helped millions of patients in the fight against cancer, kidney diseases, rheumatoid arthritis, and other serious illnesses.
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed, and highly accomplished people who respect each other but compete intensely to win. Together, we live the Amgen values as we continue advancing science to serve patients.

Job Description
Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Manager, R&D Business Operations, Budget Management & Execution
What You Will Do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, the Senior Manager, R&D Business Operations, Budget Management & Execution will lead the end-to-end budget execution process for assigned R&D organizations and serve as a trusted partner to functional leadership and R&D Finance.
The Senior Manager is accountable for the timely and high-quality delivery of annual budget planning, quarterly forecast updates and close activities, leadership reporting, and forward-looking financial insights. This role translates business priorities and changes in functional strategy into accurate budget projections and financial forecasts, helping leaders understand spending trends, risks, opportunities, and potential trade-offs.
The Senior Manager will also manage and develop members of the Budget Management & Execution team, establish consistent ways of working within the supported organization, contribute to capability standards and process improvements, and independently determine the operational approach required to meet financial and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead the end-to-end budget management and execution process for assigned R&D organization(s), including annual budget planning, quarterly forecast updates, close activities, leadership updates, and other periodic financial deliverables.
- Serve as the primary Budget Management & Execution partner for functional leadership and R&D Finance, ensuring financial forecasts reflect business priorities, evolving strategy, and the prioritization of activities.
- Translate changes in baseline spend, portfolio or operational assumptions, resource needs, and business priorities into clear financial implications, forecasts, risks, and recommended actions.
- Maintain disciplined governance of budget plans, including reconciliation of actuals and commitments to plan and identification of meaningful forecast variances and emerging spending trends.
- Lead the collection, challenge, validation, and synthesis of planning assumptions and long-range spend drivers supporting annual budget and long-range planning activities.
- Develop leadership-ready financial reporting, analyses, and narratives that clearly communicate budget status, drivers of change, risks and opportunities, resource utilization, and decision points.
- Provide analytical support for functional initiatives, productivity opportunities, scenario development, and business case generation, including measurement of expected and realized benefits where appropriate.
- Enable execution of capital and operating expense plans through forecasting, funding alignment, financial tracking, and partnership with relevant functional and finance stakeholders.
- Provide expert budget execution support across the procure-to-pay process, resolving escalated issues and partnering with transactional finance, sourcing, and other business partners to improve execution and controls.
- Lead and coordinate finance-driven periodic activities such as accruals, purchase order maintenance, forecast updates, and ad hoc financial exercises.
- Serve as an advanced user of financial planning, reporting, and collaboration systems and promote consistent application of tools, processes, and data standards across the supported organization.
- Advance self-service and data-driven decision making by improving dashboards, reporting products, analytics, and other tools that provide leaders with timely and actionable financial insights.
- Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of Budget Management & Execution processes, standards, tools, and operating practices, identifying opportunities to simplify work, strengthen controls, improve cycle time, and increase scalability.
- Contribute business-partner perspective to R&D Finance, Corporate Finance, and other cross-functional initiatives affecting budget management and execution.
- Build and maintain strong partnerships across R&D functions, R&D Finance and FP&A, Global Strategic Sourcing, transactional finance, Supplier Management & Performance Analytics, and other business and corporate partners.

People Leadership
- Manage the day-to-day activities and priorities of assigned Budget Management & Execution team members, ensuring high-quality and consistent delivery across supported functions.
- Translate business plans and objectives into clear priorities, assignments, timelines, and expectations for the team.
- Provide coaching, feedback, training, and development to direct reports and other team members, helping build financial, analytical, business-partnering, and leadership capabilities.
- Allocate resources and adjust team priorities as business needs evolve while maintaining delivery of core financial commitments.
- Foster a collaborative, inclusive, customer-focused environment that encourages continuous improvement, strong judgment, and accountability for results.

What We Expect of You
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a future-ready leader who brings financial and business acumen, operational rigor, strong people leadership, and a continuous-improvement mindset—someone who can simplify complexity, elevate insights, and influence across a matrix to drive outcomes.

Doctorate degree and 2 years of biotech/pharma business operations and/or financial analytics experience
OR
Master’s degree and 4 years of biotech/pharma business operations and/or financial analytics experience
OR
Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of biotech/pharma business operations and/or financial analytics experience
OR
Associate’s degree and 10 years of biotech/pharma business operations and/or financial analytics experience
OR
High school diploma / GED and 12 years of biotech/pharma business operations and/or financial analytics experience

Preferred Qualifications
- Advanced degree in business, finance, life sciences, or a related field.

The Operations Finance Manager will play a key role in supporting Amgen’s Operations Finance team through financial planning, analysis, reporting, and business partnering. Job Description
The Pharmacovigilance Operations Senior Manager provides strategic leadership and operational oversight of the global safety system and associated data mart to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely safety data analytics and reporting. This role is accountable for driving system performance, data integrity, inspection readiness, and regulatory compliance while advancing adoption of automation, artificial intelligence (AI), and innovative technologies across the pharmacovigilance ecosystem. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Senior Manager partners closely with Pharmacovigilance stakeholders to deliver scalable, future-ready solutions that enhance efficiency, insight generation, and regulatory confidence.

Key Responsibilities
Global Safety Systems & Data Governance
- Provide leadership and oversight for changes, enhancements, and configurations of the global safety system and associated data mart.
- Own data integrity, consistency, and reliability standards for safety data used in analytics, regulatory submissions, and decision-making.
- Oversee system configurations, including reporting rules, product and study setup, and integration points.
- Direct and govern User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities to ensure validated, inspection-ready system changes.
- Partner with Safety Technology and Managed Services to optimize system performance, support models, and service delivery.

Safety Data Outputs & Regulatory Reporting
- Own the strategy, prioritization and delivery of safety data outputs supporting: Periodic safety reporting (e.g., PADER, PSUR, DSUR), Signal detection and safety surveillance & Regulatory inquiries, audits, and inspections
- Ensure timely, high-quality delivery of automated and scheduled safety reports.
- Establish quality oversight, peer review standards, and continuous improvement for safety data outputs.
- Lead the definition and implementation of reporting solutions, including: User-defined reports, Query By Example (QBE) & Optimized search strategies aligned with global standards
- Translate business requirements into scalable, compliant reporting solutions.

Study Start-Up & Systems Integration
Provide strategic oversight for study start-up and integration activities, including:
- EDC–Safety Database integrations (e.g., RAVE/Veeva to LSMV/Argus)
- Review and approval of Mapping Specifications Worksheets (MSWs)
- UAT planning, execution, and documentation
- Ensure integrations meet regulatory, validation, and data quality expectations.

Automation, AI & Innovation Leadership
- Define and drive the roadmap for automation, AI, and advanced analytics within pharmacovigilance operations.
- Lead the evaluation, implementation, and validation of innovative technologies, including: AI-assisted case processing, Signal detection and analytics solutions & Reporting and workflow automation
- Partner cross-functionally to pilot and operationalize new capabilities while ensuring compliance, data integrity, and inspection readiness.
- Monitor emerging technologies, industry trends, and regulatory expectations related to AI in pharmacovigilance.
- Establish governance, documentation, and change management frameworks to ensure sustainable and compliant adoption of innovation.

Training, Process Excellence & Capability Building
- Lead the development and delivery of training for safety systems, reporting tools, and associated processes.
- Drive process standardization and continuous improvement through SOPs, work instructions and user documentation.
- Mentor and develop team members, strengthening technical depth and leadership capability.

Compliance & Inspection Readiness
- Execute activities delegated by the Qualified Person for Pharmacovigilance (QPPV) as defined in the PV System Master File.
- Maintain a continuous state of inspection readiness across systems, data, and processes.
- Serve as a primary representative for: Health Authority inspections, Internal and external audits
- Own audit responses and remediation activities within scope of responsibility.

Knowledge, Skills, and Experience
Technical & Functional Expertise
- Deep expertise in pharmacovigilance safety systems, preferably ArisGlobal LifeSphere.
- Strong experience with reporting and analytics platforms (e.g., Cognos, Spotfire, Tableau).
- Working knowledge of Oracle databases, Oracle Developer, and programming languages (e.g., Python, PL/SQL).
- Solid understanding of data warehousing, analytics, and data mining techniques.
- Proven experience with SDLC, system validation, and regulated development standards.

Regulatory & Domain Expertise
- Strong understanding of global pharmacovigilance regulations and safety reporting requirements.
- In-depth knowledge of clinical trial and pharmacovigilance operational processes.
- Experience supporting regulatory inspections and internal audits in a leadership capacity.
- Ability to interpret and apply aggregate safety data and analytics to regulatory and business decisions.

Leadership & Professional Skills
- Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives with minimal oversight.
- Strong strategic thinking, prioritization, and execution skills.
- Decisive problem-solver with sound judgment and escalation instincts.
- Executive-level written and verbal communication skills.
- Demonstrated ability to influence, build partnerships, and lead through change.

Experience
- Pharmaceutical industry and/or health authority experience required.
- Prior experience supporting pharmacovigilance systems, safety data analytics, or regulatory reporting strongly preferred.
- C ase management experience is strongly preferred.

Education
- Doctorate degree OR
- Master’s degree and 3 years of directly related experience OR
- Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of directly related experience OR
- Associate’s degree and 10 years of directly related experience OR High school diploma / GED and 12 years of directly related experience

The ERP Run Lead plays a critical leadership role in ensuring the reliability, security, and compliance of Amgen’s enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems. - Identify and implement process and technology enhancements to improve ERP system resilience and user experience.

- Champion automation, standardization, and modernization within the ERP Run operations.

- Leverage metrics and data insights to drive service improvements and optimize total cost of ownership.

- Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders on ERP service performance and improvement opportunities.

Basic Qualifications and Experience:
- Master’s degree with 12 - 15 years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field OR

- Bachelor’s degree with 14 - 17 years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field

Functional Skills

Must-Have Skills:

- Demonstrated success leading ERP operations for large, global, and regulated enterprises, ensuring system stability, compliance, and operational excellence.

- Deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA , BTP and RISE with SAP operations, including monitoring, incident/change management, and end-to-end system integrations.

Professional Certifications :

Soft Skills:

- Strategic and systems-level thinking with a focus on operational resilience, efficiency, and continuous improvement.

- Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across Technology, Quality, Manufacturing, and Business teams.

- Clear and confident communicator, capable of translating complex technical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.

- Effective under pressure, skilled at prioritizing and executing multiple initiatives within tight timelines.

- High initiative and accountability, with a results-oriented and ownership-driven mindset.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a pragmatic approach to decision-making.

- Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop diverse global and virtual teams in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Data Analytics, Technology & Innovation
jobs.description:
Career Category
Finance
Job Description
Senior Manager Data Analytics, Technology & Innovation
What you will do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will lead data analytics, automation, and technology innovation initiatives within Corporate Audit. You will execute the Corporate Audit technology strategy, oversee audit technology platforms, organize technical training to upskill staff, and support the leadership team with innovation, data, automation, and reporting. This includes creating and overseeing processes for receiving and transferring data to and from business partner systems, transforming and combining data from multiple sources, designing data structures, developing critical metrics, and delivering reporting solutions that support Corporate Audit objectives.
This role will help Corporate Audit continue to strengthen Amgen’s control environment by embedding data analytics and automation into audit planning, scoping, execution, reporting, risk assessment, and monitoring activities. The role will partner across Corporate Audit, Information Systems, Finance, Compliance, Operations, and external vendors to identify technology-enabled opportunities that improve audit effectiveness, increase speed, reduce manual effort, and provide meaningful insight across Amgen’s audit universe.
Corporate Audit provides independent, objective assurance and consulting services designed to add value and improve Amgen’s operations. Corporate Audit supports the achievement of Amgen’s business objectives by applying a systematic, disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness of risk management, control, and governance processes.
Key responsibilities include:
Audit Analytics, Automation & Innovation
- Lead Corporate Audit’s data analytics, automation, and technology innovation initiatives, including the ongoing development and execution of the department’s technology roadmap.
- Analyze data to identify and implement analytics, automation, and reporting solutions that provide meaningful insight and improve the effectiveness of audit planning and execution across the audit universe.
- Embed analytics into audit methodology and related processes, including risk assessment, audit planning, scoping, fieldwork, exception analysis, issue impact quantification, corrective action validation, and reporting.
- Drive automation opportunities that streamline audit procedures, improve consistency, and reduce manual effort across Corporate Audit activities.

Data Management, Reporting & Technology Enablement
- Design and develop processes to extract data from internal and external sources, transform the data into meaningful business and audit-relevant elements, combine data across sources, and load data into appropriate data structures for analysis and reporting.
- Support audit teams through onboarding new data sets, maintaining existing data sets, and enabling continued access to relevant systems, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
- Develop metrics, key risk indicators, key performance indicators, dashboards, and other reporting solutions to make data-driven insights available to audit teams, business partners, and leadership.
- Provide production support for data-related processes to ensure business continuity, performance, and integrity of reports, dashboards, automations, and other business-visible data solutions.

Business Partnership & Audit Support
- Work collaboratively with IT teams, internal business partners, audit teams, and external vendors to identify, understand, implement, and support new technology capabilities while maintaining alignment to Corporate Audit objectives.
- Maintain and enhance analytics that support affiliate audits, distributor audits, investigations, functional audits, IS audits, SOX-related activities, third-party reviews, and other Corporate Audit services.
- Be an analytics business partner to customers in the Compliance organization.

Leadership, Training & Continuous Improvement
- Support continuous improvement of Corporate Audit’s technology ecosystem, including audit management systems, collaboration tools, reporting platforms, automation tools, and data visualization solutions.
- Partner with audit leadership to identify training needs, deliver technical training, and build data analytics and technology capabilities across the Corporate Audit team.
- Exercise sound judgment and initiative in handling business issues of significance to Corporate Audit and Amgen.
- Support special projects and strategic initiatives as needed.
- Travel: International and domestic travel up to 10% may be necessary to support clients, audits, or training.

What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The audit analytics and technology professional we seek is a collaborative, innovative, and analytical leader with these qualifications.
Basic Qualifications
Doctorate degree and 8 years of data analytics, audit, finance, information systems, or related experience
Or
Master’s degree and 10 years of data analytics, audit, finance, information systems, or related experience
Or
Bachelor’s degree and 12 years of data analytics, audit, finance, information systems, or related experience
Or
Associate’s degree and 14 years of data analytics, audit, finance, information systems, or related experience
Or
High school diploma / GED and 14+ years of data analytics, audit, finance, information systems, or related experience
Preferred Qualifications
Audit, Risk & Control Experience
- 12+ years of demonstrated success in roles involving business process analysis, data analysis, audit analytics, audit automation, or large technology-related projects.
- Experience applying data analytics within internal audit, compliance, finance, information systems, SOX, or risk management processes.
- Experience with audit analytics, computer-assisted audit techniques, continuous risk monitoring, exception-based testing, or data-driven audit planning and scoping.
- Knowledge of internal audit standards, risk management, governance, controls, and audit methodology.
- Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, finance, compliance, internal audit, external audit, or Fortune 500 experience.

Data, Analytics & Technology Skills
- Experience identifying, analyzing, interpreting, and communicating trends or patterns in complex data sets.
- Proficiency with data cleansing, blending, validation, transformation, and analysis using tools such as Alteryx Designer, Databricks, SAS, Python, SQL, or similar technologies.
- Experience developing dashboards and visual analytics using Tableau, Power BI, or similar visualization platforms.
- Experience with automation technologies and workflow tools such as Power Automate, UiPath, AuditBoard (Optro), Smartsheet, Microsoft Forms, or similar platforms.
- Familiarity with enterprise applications and data sources such as SAP, Concur, Workday, C3, Veeva, AuditBoard (Optro), data lakes, or enterprise data warehouses.

Leadership, Collaboration & Professional Credentials
- Strong project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders.
- Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and collaborate effectively with individuals at all levels.
- Ability to work successfully in a highly matrixed environment with audit teams, technology teams, business partners, and external vendors.
- Self-motivated, detail-oriented, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, demanding, and dynamic work environment.
- Professional certifications such as CIA, CISA, CPA, CISSP, CRISC, CISM, CGEIT, PMP, or relevant data analytics / technology certifications.

Thrive
What you can expect of us
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being.
- Full support and career-development resources to expand your skills, enhance your expertise, and maximize your potential along your career journey.
- A diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where teammates are empowered to bring ideas to the table and act.
- Opportunities to work on meaningful initiatives that strengthen Amgen’s risk management, control, governance, and technology capabilities.
- A collaborative environment that values innovation, continuous improvement, and practical application of technology to solve business challenges.
- Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with Amgen’s Total Rewards philosophy.

Senior Associate, Organizational Design & Analytics

Job Summary
The Senior Associate, Organizational Design & Analytics supports the maintenance of organizational designs and the delivery of organizational design and workforce-planning activities across Amgen. The role partners with HR, Finance, business functions, and leaders to produce clear insights, maintain hiring governance, support operational activities, and translate complex workforce data into effective reports and presentations.
The successful candidate will bring strong analytical and creative capabilities, particularly advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, and will use approved AI-enabled tools, including Codex, responsibly to improve the quality, efficiency, and impact of team deliverables.

- Develop accurate, insightful, and visually effective reports and presentations for leaders, HR Business Partners, and other stakeholders.

- Partner with leaders to organize, analyze, and synthesize workforce reports, enabling clear communication and informed decision-making.

- Support leaders and the team with operational activities, including planning, tracking actions, preparing meeting materials, and following up on agreed deliverables.

- Maintain hiring activation plans across assigned geographies and ensure requirements are activated in accordance with global processes, policies, and compliance requirements.

- Strengthen hiring governance and adherence to established guardrails to support disciplined workforce planning.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, formulas, pivot tables, dashboards, and reporting.

- Strong PowerPoint skills, with the ability to develop concise, compelling, and visually polished presentations for leadership audiences.

- Strong stakeholder-management skills and comfort working with senior leaders.

- Effective problem-solving skills, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach.

jobs.title: Director, Commercial Analytics - Obesity
jobs.description:
Career Category
Operations
Job Description
Director, Commercial Analytics

Obesity Intelligence & Analytics | Amgen India
Reports to: Executive Director, Obesity Intelligence & Analytics
Role Summary
This is an India-based global leadership role supporting Amgen's global obesity business, with significant focus on the U.S. market. The role builds the commercial analytics capability that informs strategy, sales execution, customer engagement, payer/pricing decisions, and growth priorities.
The mandate is to turn ambiguous questions into clear choices. Working with global commercial leaders and U.S. stakeholders, this leader converts business needs into scalable analysis, decision frameworks, and reusable insight products that help leaders allocate resources, identify execution gaps, and act with confidence.
Success requires sound commercial judgment, clear executive communication, and a strong understanding of U.S. pharmaceutical selling models, field dynamics, HCP and account engagement, and the data ecosystems used to guide commercialization. The Director will build and continuously strengthen an India-based commercial analytics capability recognized by global commercial leaders for trusted judgment, execution excellence, measurable business impact, and the ability to anticipate evolving business needs.
Key Responsibilities
1. Commercial Analytics Strategy & Prioritization
- Set the commercial analytics agenda for obesity, including roadmap, delivery priorities, and senior decision forums.
- Turn product, field, account, payer/pricing, and U.S. stakeholder questions into pragmatic analytical plans and usable decision assets.
- Bring discipline to intake, prioritization, quality, governance, and execution without creating unnecessary process burden.
- Surface risks, options, and trade-offs early, backed by evidence and grounded in commercial reality.
- Raise the standard for reusable methods, continuously evolve how the function works, and build capabilities that improve over time as business needs change.

2. Product, Launch & External Intelligence
- Shape analysis that informs product strategy, commercialization readiness, lifecycle planning, and in-market action.
- Track the competitive landscape, treatment environment, access/pricing shifts, HCP behavior, and external signals, with strong attention to U.S. dynamics.
- Synthesize market, customer, competitive, and policy insights into clear assessments of launch readiness.
- Synthesize diverse internal and external data to identify opportunities, risks, and strategic priorities. Convert them into executive-ready narratives that clarify implications and decisions.

3. HCP, Account & Field Effectiveness
- Lead analysis for field sizing, customer segmentation, HCP/account engagement, and field execution.
- Develop national and sub-national insights that guide resource allocation, launch sequencing, and customer prioritization
- Work across commercial, medical, market access, and product teams to evaluate strategic options and inform planning.
- Advance patient journey, market landscape, and stakeholder insights to inform priorities.
- Develop executive-ready insights that anticipate risks, highlight opportunities, and enable confident choices.

4. Advanced Analytics & Decision Translation
- Develop predictive models, scenario simulations, segmentation approaches, and driver analyses to answer high-value business questions.
- Apply quantitative techniques to estimate demand, assess adoption drivers, and evaluate the impact of market and competitive changes.
- Industrialize analytical methods through scalable, governed, and reusable solutions in partnership with data science and technology teams.
- Establish analytical standards, validation practices, and documentation that improve consistency, transparency, and confidence in outputs.
- Expand the use of automation, AI, and experimentation to accelerate delivery and increase analytical rigor.

5. Operating Model & Capability Building
- Own the commercial analytics operating model for domain intake, prioritization, standards, delivery cadence, quality, and adoption.
- Standardize recurring work into reusable insight products, tools, and methods where scale creates value.
- Clarify how the function partners with forecasting, primary market research, and technology colleagues to deliver integrated work.
- Improve speed, consistency, and impact through pragmatic reuse, automation, and fit-for-purpose solutions.
- Build a connected capability recognized by the global obesity business for judgment, reliability, and business partnership.

6. Team Leadership & Talent Development
- Build, develop, and lead a high-performing India-based team of analytics professionals.
- Create an environment of analytical excellence, accountability, curiosity, continuous learning, and ownership.
- Coach future leaders by expanding their commercial judgment, technical depth, strategic thinking, executive communication, and ability to influence across a global organization.
- Set clear goals, performance expectations, and development paths that link individual growth to organizational priorities.
- Inspire the team to understand the business behind the analysis while creating an environment where curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning are expected and rewarded.

Basic Qualifications
- Doctorate degree OR Master's degree OR Bachelor's degree and 18+ years of relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications
- Advanced degree in Business, Analytics, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Data Science, Life Sciences, Public Health, or a related field.
- Substantial experience in commercial analytics, strategic insights, consulting, or related functions within pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, healthcare, or life sciences.
- Depth across product/brand strategy, launch analytics, sales force effectiveness, HCP/account analytics, payer/pricing analysis, commercial measurement, and executive insight translation.
- Experience supporting U.S. or global launches and growth assets in competitive, rapidly evolving therapeutic categories, ideally with high access and execution complexity.
- Strong understanding of U.S. pharmaceutical commercialization, selling models, field execution, stakeholder prioritization, and healthcare ecosystem dynamics.
- Knowledge of U.S. healthcare data ecosystems used for commercial decision-making, including sales, field activity, promotional engagement, claims, payer/pricing, and access-related data.
- Proven ability to translate complex analysis into recommendations that influence senior stakeholders and action planning.
- Experience partnering with technology, data science, and data engineering teams to develop scalable analytics products.
- Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, strategic thinking, and ability to balance practical delivery with high-quality analytical standards in a global environment.

.

jobs.title: Advanced Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Career Category
Engineering
Job Description
HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?
If you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of.

Live | What you will do
- Lead the design and execution of marketing mix models (MMM) to evaluate brand promotional effectiveness and inform investment decisions.
- Analyze trends across channels and campaigns to provide guidance on resource allocation and return on marketing investments.
- Translate complex model outputs into actionable insights and business recommendations through compelling visual and narrative storytelling.
- Build dashboards, PowerPoint summaries, and talking points for brand leadership and US-based commercial stakeholders.
- Collaborate with US brand teams, marketing, finance, and vendor partners to align on inputs, assumptions, and interpretation of results.
- Work hands-on in Databricks using Python/PySpark and SQL to clean, transform, and model large marketing and sales datasets.
- Mentor junior analysts in marketing measurement and coding best practices as needed.

Thrive | What you can expect
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being.

Basic Qualifications
- Master’s degree (or Bachelor’s with equivalent experience) in Economics, Data Science, Applied Statistics, or related field.
- 8–12 years of experience in analytics, with direct experience building or applying MMM in a pharma or healthcare context.
- Strong Python and SQL skills with experience using Databricks or equivalent cloud-based environments.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with ability to influence commercial decision-makers.
- Demonstrated ability to translate technical analyses into business-friendly insights.

Preferred Qualifications
- Exposure to media measurement, marketing channel optimization, or omnichannel campaign analysis.
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams across marketing, finance, and vendors.
- Familiarity with causal inference methods or simulation techniques.
- Strong business acumen and comfort presenting to senior stakeholders in commercial or brand leadership.

jobs.title: Commercial Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
Career Category
Engineering
Job Description
Commercial Analytics Manager
Amgen India (AIN)
The Commercial Analytics team at Amgen plays a pivotal role as a strategic partner to Commercial leadership, delivering high-quality analyses and data-backed insights crucial for driving US commercial performance. This role is part of Amgen’s growing analytics capability in India and works closely with US-based Commercial and Global Customer Capabilities Innovation teams to execute analytical work, generate insights, and support decision-making across the business.
As our Commercial Analytics Manager, you are responsible for guiding analytical approaches and ensuring collaboration across different functional teams. The Manager will partner with the Senior Manager to ensure day-to-day delivery of recommendations and develop an objective and rigorous perspective. The role demands strong commercial analytics expertise, problem solving, and the ability to independently execute analytic plans to generate insights.

Live | What you will do
1. Performance Analytics & Insight Delivery
- Lead the design and execution of analytic plans for specific business questions across multiple secondary data sources to support strategic decision-making.
- Deliver performance analytics to understand brand drivers, payer/access shifts, promotional impact, field dynamics, and competitive trends.
- Support translation of US business questions into structured analytical approaches and apply appropriate methods and datasets.
- Develop clear, actionable, and objective insights that support brand planning, portfolio discussions, and commercial execution.
- Apply strong US commercial understanding to ensure insights are relevant and strategically grounded.
- Execute production, quality, and interpretation of standard performance reports and dashboards (weekly, monthly, quarterly).
- Manage collective ownership of understanding data sources, business rules, and caveats, ensuring confidence and accuracy in all outputs.

2. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication
- Partner with US teams across forecasting, market research, value and access, decision science, and reporting/visualization.
- Communicate findings clearly, synthesizing complex analysis into concise narratives and visuals for US stakeholders.
- Engage regularly with counterparts to refine requirements, validate assumptions, and align outputs to provide an objective data-driven perspective on performance.
- Actively identify risks and performance signals, ensuring timely collaboration with US teams.
- Maintain consistency and documentation of methods, KPI definitions, and analytical standards.

3. Analytics Execution, Quality & Team Culture
- Lead execution of specific analytical efforts within the team, ensuring accuracy, rigor, and reproducibility.
- Contribute to automation and productization efforts that reduce manual effort and speed up insights.
- Support AI-enabled analytics by preparing data and partnering on automated outputs.
- Ensure analytical work adheres to applicable legal, regulatory, and compliance SOPs across internal teams and vendor partners.
- Contribute to building capability in analytics, interpretation, and communication.
- Embody a culture of curiosity, accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement across the India team.

Thrive | What you can expect
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being.
Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor’s with 8-13 years or Master’s with 6 years of relevant sales & marketing operations, and/or analytics experience.
- Strong SQL, Excel, and Python skills, with working knowledge of Tableau and cloud data services (AWS, Databricks).
- Strong ability and direct experience with analyzing, synthesizing, and integrating various secondary data sources specific to US commercial pharma.
- Strong understanding of measurement frameworks, critical metrics, and performance evaluation in a commercial context.

Preferred Qualifications
- Strong interpersonal and planning skills; comfort independently manage project timelines and develop contingencies.
- Understanding of the strengths and limitations of different analytical approaches.
- Proven ability to influence collaborators and lead cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
- Strong communication skills with ability to verbally and visually convey a compelling, concise narrative to different audiences.
- Ability to drive implementation to enhance methodologies and standard processes.

.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Role Description:
The Senior Medical Data Scientist will play a vital role in supporting Global Medical Affairs by designing and deploying data science solutions — including advanced statistical methods, predictive modeling, and machine learning — to deliver meaningful, data-driven insights that inform scientific engagement, strategic decision-making, and patient-focused strategies.
As a key member of the Medical Data & Analytics (MDnA) team, you will translate complex structured and unstructured data into actionable intelligence to inform medical strategy and improve patient outcomes. This is a hands-on, technical, and execution-oriented role that requires both analytical depth and strong problem-solving skills. The ideal candidate is an advanced problem solver who combines deep data science expertise, hands-on technical skills, and a strong ability to mentor, motivate and elevate peers. This is an opportunity to continuously expand their expertise and take a role in pushing forward innovative analytics such as large language models (LLMs) and Generative AI.
Key Responsibilities
- Design and build high-impact projects that address complex medical questions across therapeutic areas, applying advanced data science methods (predictive modeling, NLP, LLMs, machine learning, causal inference).
- Conduct end-to-end data science projects across structured and unstructured datasets (e.g., HCP sentiment, scientific engagement data, publications, CRM/field medical data) using Python, R, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
- Drive the design, application, and evaluation of test-and-learn approaches — including causal inference methods, advanced A/B testing, and pilots, with accountability for methodological rigor and actionable insights.
- Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to define problem statements, set project scope, and design and conduct medical data science projects such as MSL engagement optimization, MSL note sentiment analysis using LLMs, and digital engagement impact measurement, turning complex data into insights that enable more effective field medical activities.
- Design and optimize scalable data pipelines in collaboration with engineering teams, ensuring reproducibility, robustness, and compliance in deployment workflows.
- Translate complex model outputs into clear, actionable insights and recommendations and deliver compelling presentations, reports, and visualizations to medical and cross-functional leadership teams.
- Serve as a technical SME (subject matter expert) in data science, providing thought influencing designing and methodology choices across the MDnA team.
- Passion to continuously learn, evaluate and introduce emerging technologies (e.g., Generative AI, LLMs, advanced A/B testing frameworks) and act as a motivational peer to strengthen Amgen’s data science toolbox.
- Maintain best practices in reproducibility, documentation, version control, and model governance across teams.

Basic Qualifications:
- PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative field and 2+ year(s) of experience in data analytics or data science; OR,

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative field and 5+ years of experience in data analytics or data science; OR,
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related quantitative field and 7+ years of experience in data analytics or data science.
- Experience in data science, statistics, machine learning, or advanced analytics, with hands-on application of statistical techniques such as hypothesis testing, regression analysis, clustering, and classification.
- Demonstrated hands-on expertise in data science, statistical modeling, machine learning, advanced predictive modeling, NLP, or related fields, with successful delivery of end-to-end solutions.
- Advanced programming in SQL and Python (R a plus); comfort working in Databricks or similar environments.
- Strong storytelling and presentation skills; ability to translate data into clear, compelling insights.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Life sciences or pharma experience, with proven application of data science.
- Deep understanding of machine learning frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch).
- Practical experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, or advanced NLP applications is a strong plus.
- Familiarity with MLflow, AWS, Git, and DevOps-style model deployment workflows.
- Track record of peer mentorship and leadership within technical teams.

Soft Skills:
- Curiosity, adaptability, and a passion for continuous learning.
- Motivational influence: ability to inspire and elevate the performance of peers.
- Strong problem-solving and critical thinking.
- Effective communication, both written and verbal.
- Collaborative mindset and ability to work in a matrixed environment.
