jobs.title: Area Network Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Career Category
Marketing
Job Description
ポジション概要
Area Network Marketing Manager（ANMM）は、担当地域において、地域特性に応じた骨粗鬆症診療ネットワークを構築・稼働・定着させる、実行力を核とするマーケティング職である。
基幹病院、クリニック、地域医師会をつなぎ、骨粗鬆症患者さんが適切なタイミングで評価され、重症度に応じた紹介、治療開始・継続・フォローアップに至る地域の患者導線を整備する。自治体との協業が地域の患者導線上の課題解決に有用な場合は、その機会と実装要件を特定し、V&AおよびMedical部門と連携して、コンプライアンスに沿った協業を推進する。Brand Planを地域で実行可能なquick winに翻訳し、地域ごとに最適な連携モデルを設計・推進する。
病院内におけるBone Care Pathway（BCP）の実装が進みつつある一方、地域に患者さんの受け皿が設計されていなければ、病院外来の負荷が過度に高まるおそれがある。ANMMは、病院で治療された患者さんを地域のクリニックにつなぐ、ならびにクリニックから病院またはDXA保有施設への適切な紹介が行われる仕組みを構築する。

主な業務内容
地域ネットワークの設計・優先順位付け（実行・定着と探索の両立）
- 患者導線、診断・紹介上の課題、施設の準備度、ステークホルダーの影響力を分析し、優先地域と最適な連携モデルを特定する。あわせて、患者導線上の課題、主要関係者、役割分担、実装障壁、KPIを明確にした地域別実行計画を策定・更新する。
- 共通の運用ルールを守りながら、地域の患者導線や課題に応じて、必要な施策を「カフェテリア方式」で選択・組み合わせ、地域別実行計画を設計する。短期に実行・定着できるquick winと、将来のインパクトを生む新たな連携・患者導線モデルに関する探索的な取り組みを、バランスよく優先順位付けする。

連携の仕組みづくり・稼働化・定着
- 基幹病院とクリニック間に、評価・治療方針決定への紹介、地域での継続治療・フォローアップを可能にする、地域の診療連携の実情に即した仕組みを構築・稼働させる。
- 定期的なフォローアップと課題解決の運営を整備し、ネットワークの継続的な機能化を図る。
- 適切な情報管理方法に基づき、地域のクリニック等の受入可否・必要条件を把握し、地域連携の設計・運用改善に反映する。ANMMは、個別患者の紹介先選定または紹介判断を代行しない。

外部ステークホルダーおよび自治体連携の推進
- 医師、病院・クリニックの責任者、地域医師会に直接働きかけ、地域の課題に対する解決策の実装を主導する。
- 自治体との協業が必要な場合は、地域課題、医療連携の設計、関係者の役割、期待成果を明確化する。自治体または自治体関係者への適切な説明・協業窓口はV&AおよびMedical部門が主体となって担い、ANMMは地域インサイトと医療連携の設計・実装支援を提供する。

フィールドおよびクロスファンクショナルとの実行連携
- MR、DSM、eMR、API-CSC、UCB-ODLと緊密に連携し、機会の特定、顧客の巻き込み、実装障壁の解消を行う。
- Medical、V&A、Corporate Affairs等の社内ステークホルダーと連携し、公衆衛生（スクリーニング）と医療をつなぐ取り組みを含む実装障壁を解消する。
- 承認済みの資材、スクリプト、プロセスおよび情報共有方法を使用する。不明確なケースまたは例外的なケースでは、活動を中止し、適切なガバナンスプロセスに沿ってエスカレーションおよび記録を行う。

既存ネットワークの稼働・定着、探索、ONST(Osteoporosis National Screening)プロジェクトとの連携
- 既存の地域ネットワークを定期的にレビューし、課題解決と実行品質の改善を通じて、継続的な稼働と成果創出を担保する。
- 優先課題に対して、新たな連携・患者導線モデルを仮説、対象範囲、成功基準、評価時点を明確にして探索する。検証済みのモデルは定着・横展開し、成果見込みが限定的な取り組みは速やかに見直す、または中止する。
- 長期的な公衆衛生・政策連携を担うONST Projectとは定期的に連携し、該当するパイロット地域では医療連携・患者導線の設計を支援する。参画施設数、稼働した連携の仕組み等の活動KPI、紹介・逆紹介の稼働状況等の行動KPI、探索から横展開への移行マイルストーン、および担当エリアのビジネス貢献をバランスよく管理し、Brand Planに沿った成果創出につなげる。

役割範囲と主要な連携先
- Area Network Marketing Lead：ANMMチームの戦略、人材、優先順位、成果管理、および成功モデルの横展開を担う。
- eMR：主にNon-targetを中心に、Area Network Marketing ManagerおよびMRの後方支援を担う。
- API-CSC：二次性骨折予防継続管理料イロハを算定する医療機関を中心に、基幹病院とクリニックの循環型地域連携を担う。
- UCB Osteoporosis Disease Liaison（ODL）：主として院内のBCP実装および外来ワークフロー支援を担う。
- ONST Project：公衆衛生・政策面の連携を伴う、長期的かつ構造化されたスクリーニングから治療への取り組みを担う。ANMMは、V&AおよびMedical部門と連携し、必要に応じて地域インサイト、医療連携の設計、実装面の支援を行う。

コアコンピテンシー
- 地域ネットワークの成果と継続的な稼働に対する当事者意識と高い実行力を発揮する。
- 構造的な問題解決力を用い、地域の実装障壁を特定し、機会を優先順位付けする。
- 多様な社内外ステークホルダーとの信頼関係と合意形成を構築する。
- 複数の優先事項を管理しながら、戦略を実務的な地域アクションに落とし込む。
- 既存ネットワークを確実に稼働・定着させる力と、規律ある探索を両立し、学びを横展開、見直し、または中止の判断につなげる。

必須要件
経験
- ステークホルダーマッピング、ネットワーク構築、組織横断プロジェクトのリード経験。
- 営業、アカウントマネジメント、マーケティング、ヘルスケアエコシステム構築、または関連領域での経験。

知識・スキル
- 骨粗鬆症診療、紹介連携、日本の治療環境に関する理解。
- 医師、病院・クリニック、医師会を巻き込み、合意形成を進める能力。自治体との協業においては、V&AおよびMedical部門と連携し、コンプライアンスに沿って推進する能力。
- 地域の機会を見極め、戦略を実行に落とし込む商業的・分析的能力。
- 強い協働力、および関連法令、業界コード、社内ポリシーに関する理解。

歓迎要件
- ビジネスレベルの英語力

.

Reporting to the Commercial Lead, the District Promotion Manager provides leadership and direction to the field team within the assigned district, with accountability for delivering business and promotional objectives while ensuring strong execution of Amgen’s commercial strategy.
The role is responsible for leading, coaching and developing a high-performing team of Biopharmaceutical Representatives , translating brand and business priorities into effective district execution, and leveraging customer and market insights to optimize performance.
As a key field leader, the District Promotion Manager works cross-functionally to strengthen customer engagement, support business growth and ensure that all activities are conducted in accordance with Amgen policies, internal standards and applicable local regulations .

Key Responsibilities
Business & Execution Leadership
- Own district performance and drive execution against agreed sales, promotional and business objectives .
- Translate national commercial and brand strategies into clear district priorities, action plans and execution standards .
- Leverage business analytics, market dynamics, customer insights and competitive intelligence to identify opportunities and drive performance.
- Ensure disciplined execution, effective resource allocation and appropriate follow-up of district KPIs.
- Support the effective execution of product launches, strategic initiatives and key business priorities within the district.

People Leadership & Capability Building
- Lead, inspire and develop a team of Biopharmaceutical Representatives , creating a culture of performance, accountability and continuous development.
- Set clear expectations and provide ongoing coaching, feedback and performance management .
- Conduct regular field visits and coaching interactions to strengthen commercial capabilities and execution excellence.
- Identify individual and team development needs and establish meaningful development plans.
- Recognize strong performance while proactively addressing performance gaps.

Customer & Cross-Functional Leadership
- Develop a strong understanding of the district healthcare environment and evolving customer needs.
- Build and maintain effective relationships with key healthcare professionals, institutions and relevant stakeholders .
- Partner effectively with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access and other cross-functional teams to ensure aligned and integrated execution.
- Bring relevant field and customer insights into business discussions to support informed decision-making and strategic planning.

Compliance & Operational Excellence
- Ensure all field and promotional activities are conducted in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, Amgen policies and SOPs .
- Maintain high standards of operational discipline, documentation and reporting.
- Manage district budgets and resources responsibly and effectively.
- Ensure timely and accurate reporting of business performance, field activities and relevant KPIs.
- Maintain appropriate documentation to support internal reviews and audit requirements.

Key Requirements
- Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Medicine, Life Sciences or a related discipline ; an advanced business degree/MBA is an advantage.
- Minimum 5 years of relevant pharmaceutical commercial experience , with at least 2 years of people management experience .
- Demonstrated track record of leading teams and delivering strong business results .
- Strong coaching and people-development capabilities, with the ability to build and sustain high-performing teams.
- Strong understanding of the local pharmaceutical market, healthcare environment and regulatory landscape .
- Demonstrated ability to translate strategy into effective field execution.
- Strong business acumen and analytical capabilities , with the ability to use data and insights to drive decisions.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.
- Ability to operate effectively in a cross-functional and matrix environment .
- Strong planning, prioritization and organizational capabilities.
- High standards of integrity and a strong commitment to compliance and ethical business practices .
- Fluency in French and Arabic ; proficiency in English is an asset.

Where Your Career Can Thrive

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being.

This role requires a combination of strong program leadership, organizational effectiveness, learning operations, GxP knowledge and the ability to work across a complex global and cross-functional environment.

- Partner with Supply Chain leadership to translate strategic priorities into coordinated plans, actions, milestones and measurable outcomes.

- Establish and maintain effective operating rhythms across key organizational priorities, including leadership reviews, initiative tracking, decision follow-up, risk management and cross-functional dependencies.

- Provide structure and visibility across strategic initiatives by consolidating progress, identifying risks and interdependencies, and enabling timely escalation and decision-making.

- Coordinate across Planning, Distribution, Enablement, Customer Service, Clinical Supply Chain and other in-scope functions to connect priorities, process knowledge, capability requirements and organizational needs.

- Develop leadership-ready materials, insights and progress updates that enable effective governance and informed decision-making.

- Support the Supply Chain knowledge-transfer plan for Amgen India onboarding, including transfer cadence, readiness assessments, risk identification, progress tracking and stakeholder coordination.

jobs.title: Sr Associate Supply Chain, RMD Buyer Lead
jobs.description:
Career Category
Supply Chain
Job Description
Sr Associate Supply Chain, RMD Buyer Lead (GCF 04)
Function: Global Supply Chain
Location: AIN
Reports To: Raw Materials Supply Planning and Buying Manager, Amgen India

Position Summary
The Sr. Associate Supply Chain, RMD Buyer Lead is responsible for executing procurement and supply chain transactions that ensure uninterrupted material availability and accurate system execution. Leads a group of buyers executing orders for the Amgen Network, operating within a signal-based execution model, this role manages and has oversight of  purchase order placement, supplier order management, invoice processing, SAP master data maintenance, and workflow execution.
The position serves as a key link between suppliers, Network Planning, Accounts Payable, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely material flow, accurate system data, and efficient procurement operations.

Key Responsibilities
Signal-Based Supply Chain Execution
- Execute procurement activities based on planning signals and system-generated requirements.
- Monitor and respond to supply exceptions to ensure continuity of material supply.
- Collaborate with Network Planners to understand demand changes and execute required procurement actions.
- Escalate supply risks, delays, and exceptions to appropriate stakeholders.

Purchase Order Management
- Create, release, and manage purchase orders in SAP.
- Communicate purchase orders and schedule requirements to suppliers.
- Maintain purchase order accuracy including quantities, delivery dates, pricing, and confirmations.
- Monitor open orders and proactively resolve discrepancies impacting supply.

Purchase Order Maintenance & Supplier Coordination
- Process purchase order updates, cancellations, and rescheduling requests.
- Manage supplier confirmations and delivery commitments.
- Coordinate with suppliers to resolve order execution issues and delivery exceptions.
- Support supplier performance through timely communication and issue resolution.

Invoice Processing & AIN Management
- Review, process, and resolve invoice discrepancies through Ariba Network (AIN) and SAP.
- Partner with Accounts Payable, suppliers, and procurement teams to resolve blocked invoices and payment issues.
- Ensure invoice processing compliance with company policies and procedures.
- Monitor invoice workflow status and drive timely resolution of exceptions.

SAP Data & System Accuracy
- Maintain accurate procurement and material master data within SAP.
- Update and manage Purchasing Info Records (PIRs), lead times, sourcing information, and procurement parameters.
- Ensure transactional accuracy across procurement systems.
- Support system audits and data quality initiatives.

Workflow & Master Data Management
- Support creation and maintenance of supplier, material, and purchasing master data.
- Monitor workflow queues and resolve pending approvals.
- Ensure compliance with established business processes and data governance standards.

Stakeholder Collaboration
- Partner closely with Network Planners to execute procurement requirements and manage supply exceptions.
- Collaborate with Manufacturing, Warehouse, Quality, Procurement, and Finance teams.
- Provide timely updates regarding order status, supplier commitments, and execution risks.
- Participate in operational reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

Accountability & Responsibilities
- Execute procurement activities in accordance with planning signals and established business processes.
- Ensure purchase orders are created, maintained, and closed accurately.
- Maintain high levels of SAP master data integrity and transactional accuracy.
- Resolve invoice exceptions and workflow issues within established service levels.
- Support supplier performance through proactive order management and communication.
- Maintain compliance with procurement policies, quality requirements, and regulatory expectations.
- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, automation, and process performance.

Basic Qualifications
Bachelor’s Degree and 2+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Purchasing, Operations, or a related field
OR
Associate Degree and 4+ years of relevant experience

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain execution, or operations.
- Strong SAP experience including Purchasing, Material Master, and Vendor Master processes.
- Experience with Ariba Network (AIN) invoice processing and supplier collaboration.
- Knowledge of Purchasing Info Records (PIRs), lead times, sourcing, and procurement master data.
- Experience managing purchase orders and supplier order execution.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
- Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Experience in a regulated manufacturing, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare environment preferred.
- Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies and operational excellence principles.

Impact
The Senior Associate, Raw Materials Planning plays a critical role in ensuring planning recommendations are accurately executed within ERP systems, enabling reliable material availability for manufacturing operations. By maintaining data integrity and disciplined transaction execution, this role directly supports uninterrupted patient supply, inventory optimization, and operational efficiency.

.

jobs.description:
Career Category
Procurement
Job Description
ABOUT AMGEN
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Role Description
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world.
At Amgen, our shared mission to serve patients drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together, researching, manufacturing, and delivering  products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide.

In this vital role, you will be responsible for managing the category strategy for Marketing Services, with a focus on Advertising and Medical Communications . As Strategic Sourcing Manager, Marketing Advertising and Medical Communication.
You will play a key role in developing and executing sourcing strategies that align with commercial, medical, and enterprise objectives. This includes leading sourcing initiatives, fostering cross-functional collaboration, and enabling third-party solutions that accelerate high-quality commercial advertising, medical communications, and compliant omnichannel engagement.
In this role, you will:
- Build and manage strategic partnerships across Global Marketing, Global Medical, Medical Affairs, Commercial, Legal, Regulatory, and Procurement teams.
- Deliver value through cost optimization, supplier innovation, improved speed-to-market, and scalable content production capabilities.
- Lead sourcing events, supplier negotiations, and contract development for commercial advertising, medical communications, medical education, promotional and non-promotional content, and content operations.
- Partner with stakeholders to optimize the end-to-end innovative content development, including modular content, digital asset management, AI-enabled content creation, and content reuse strategies.
- Help ensure supplier compliance with quality, regulatory, legal, privacy, and medical governance requirements while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Your work will help strengthen Amgen's content ecosystem by enabling compliant, high-quality, and efficient primary (core) content development and medical communications that improve customer engagement, accelerate speed-to-market, and support the company's mission and future product growth.
Key Responsibilities
- Support the development of the continuously evolving category strategy for Creative (Core) Advertising and Medical Communications, ensuring alignment with commercial, medical, and enterprise priorities.
- Lead strategic sourcing initiatives with a focus on creative and medical agencies along with related eco-system services.
- Deliver measurable business value through cost optimization, supplier innovation, operational excellence, and enhanced creative development across the category.
- Optimize total cost of ownership by improving agency service models, driving efficiency across the category while maximizing supplier performance and value.
- Monitor and improve supplier performance through structured supplier relationship management, governance, service level agreements, and performance metrics.
- Proactively identify and mitigate risks related to regulatory compliance, quality, and supplier continuity.
- Leverage data and analytics to measure category performance and key performance indicators, including speed-to-market, innovative core content development, supplier performance, and overall value realization.
- Partner cross-functionally across Global Marketing, Global Medical, Medical Affairs, Legal, Regulatory, Commercial, and regional teams to ensure sourcing strategies support enterprise standards while enabling local market needs.
- Collaborate with external partners, peer networks, and industry organizations to stay ahead of evolving agency delivery models, AI-enabled content development, medical communications trends, supplier capabilities, and industry best practices.
- Demonstrate expertise in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex commercial agreements that balance business value, quality, compliance, intellectual property protection, and enterprise procurement objectives.

Win - What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The Strategic Sourcing Management professional we seek is a Manager with these qualifications:
Basic Qualifications:
- Master’s degree and 6 years of business partnering, category management, strategic sourcing and/or related experience, OR
- Bachelor’s degree with 10+ years of experience in business partnering, category management, strategic sourcing, and/or related areas.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Demonstrated leadership in Strategic Sourcing across Creative Advertising Agency, Medical Communications, and related agency services, including supplier management, cost optimization, and performance measurement.
- Deep understanding of Strategic Sourcing principles, supplier relationship management, and contract lifecycle management within regulated healthcare and life sciences environments.
- Strong financial, legal, and contractual acumen with experience negotiating complex commercial agreements for creative agency services, medical communications and related services.
- Proven track record of driving innovation in category strategy, creative agency operating models, supplier engagement, and cross-functional stakeholder partnerships.
- Exceptional ability to communicate complex category strategies, influence senior stakeholders, and lead change across Global Marketing, Medical, Procurement, Legal, Regulatory, and regional organizations.
- Familiarity with procurement technologies such as Ariba, Scout, and Sirion Labs, as well as ERP systems and analytics platforms used to support sourcing decisions, supplier performance, and process automation.
- Experience leveraging spend analytics, supplier benchmarking, and market intelligence to inform category strategies and identify opportunities for value creation.
- Strong understanding of the regulatory and compliance environment governing pharmaceutical marketing and medical communications, including promotional  content development.
- Knowledge of emerging trends in creative agency models, modular content, digital asset management, AI-enabled content creation, and omnichannel content delivery, with the ability to translate market innovations into business value.
- Ability to articulate a forward-looking business and category vision for Creative Agency model delivery and Medical Communications and build alignment around a strategic, value-driven roadmap.

Doctorate degree and 4 years of relevant experience

Job Description
HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?
Amgen is a global leader in biotechnology with a history of more than four decades of pioneering breakthroughs. Our commitment to science has led us to discover and develop innovative therapies that significantly improve patients' lives. We also invest in cutting-edge manufacturing and support services to deliver these therapies worldwide. Japan and the Asia Pacific (JAPAC) region represent the fastest-growing area for Amgen. We are currently seeking a qualified candidate for the role of Solid Tumor M arketing Lead in Tokyo, Japan.

Live
What you will do:
The Solid Tumor Marketing Lead will have the full responsibility for the Marketing strategy and execution under the Solid Tumor franchise in Amgen KK.
The Solid Tumor Marketing Lead is accountable for the brands within the franchise and will lead the JBT (Japan Brand Team) for each brand of Solid Tumor (ALL) and also the XFT (X-functional team) in Japan. In addition, the Solid Tumor Marketing Lead will be accountable for contribution to the overall global strategy by providing insights and input from a Japan perspective (“Global with Local” contribution). This role will also be the main accountable and the main interface for all franchise brand related matters towards the GM, Oncology Business Unit Director or other Japan Operation Committee (JOC) members.
As part of this role, it is expected the Solid Tumor Marketing Lead to lead and developing the teams in the reporting lines, as well as nurturing and developing talents and ensuring strong succession planning within the TA franchise organization. As a key member of Amgen it is expected from the Solid Tumor Marketing Lead to take a proactive approach to the shaping of the Oncology Business Unit business and culture, and be a champion for the Amgen 2030 vision and Amgen’s mission “To serve patients” among its team members and within the company.
In this position, the Solid Tumor Marketing Lead is expected to have the opportunity to experience new challenges and be developed so that it can be one of the future candidates for next generation of Business Unit Directors, one of other JOC functions or even as a global leader.

Main Responsibilities
Reporting directly to the Business Unit Director of Oncology of Japan, this role is critical in overseeing all brand strategic and operational matters related to the Solid Tumor Franchises in Japan.  Your ability to collaborate across functions at local, regional, and global levels will be key.

Strategic Leadership: Develop and manage the brand strategy and ensure its successful execution to achieve or exceed business goals.
Financial Management: participate in the coordination and drive business and financial processes, including Strategy and Operations and P&L management for the Solid Tumor franchise.
Team Leadership: As a key member of the Oncology Business Unit Team, exemplify Amgen’s values and mission. Lead and develop the team to ensure high-quality strategy and execution across all Solid Tumor brands.
Talent Development: Mentor and develop top talent, set goals, conduct succession planning, and manage performance to align people’s contributions with business objectives.
Stakeholder Engagement: Represent Amgen to external stakeholders as a patient-centric partner of choice. Build long-term, productive relationships with customers and shape external strategies based on insights.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
The responsible tasks are as follows.
- Launch readiness plan: critical plan for a successful launch of new brand under the responsibility of the Product Manager. The Solid Tumor Marketing Lead has accountability and ownership of the LRR for each brand within its franchise.  On the process of planning and execution, Solid Tumor Marketing Lead should lead JBT, XFT and other stakeholders for launch.
- Brand Plan: the Solid Tumor Marketing Lead will manage the Product Managers to develop the annual Brand Plan Framework (BPF) and Plan of Action (PoA) incl. set and track financial targets per brand  (sales top-line target and necessary investment), coordinate supply needs , KGI (Key Goal Index) / KPI (Key Performance Index) while ensuring a strong communication with the cross-functional team of MA (Medical Affairs) and DM (District Manager) in Sales.
- Marketing tactics/activities: The Solid Tumor Marketing Lead will manage the Oncology Narrative Facilitator (ONF) lead and Senior Associate Marketer to operate marketing-initiated tactics and activities and to communicate with other cross-functional team of Sales dept. (NSD/National Sales Director, DM and MR) and MSL (Medical Science Liaison) in MA.
- Financial tracking: Solid Tumor Marketing Lead has clear accountability for Sales Revenue, OPEX (Operational Expense) and related KPIs by month, quarter, year and long range with BUH and Finance BP (Business Partner)
- Supply demand tracking: Solid Tumor Marketing Lead will manage the product demand proactively has the brands S&OP lead as to always ensure appropriate supply levels at all times and thus avoiding stock-out or write-offs.
- Customer network and management: Solid Tumor Marketing Lead will build up the network and good relationship with key stakeholders related to the franchise such as Pulmonologists, Hematologists and pediatrician in Solid Tumor and or Oncologists and nurses, etc.
This position has responsibility to manage its subordinates to help them to excel in their performance while being an enabler and champion for diversity, inclusion and speaking-up culture. It is also expected that this role will take a proactive approach to development of the direct reports and associated teams and allowing the employees to take up challenges beyond their comfortable zone.
This position is a leader in the cross-functional team and global team to lead in-line brands and Early oncology pipeline projects through the following governance.
- JCC (Japan Customer Council)

- BT (Brand Team)

- XFT (Cross-functional team)

- IBT/BWG (Integrated Brand Team / Brand Working Group) with global.

- LRR (Launch Readiness Review), if project in scope of launch readiness.

This position has an accountability to BUH, Finance, GM (General Manager) of Amgen KK and other Japan leadership team members, as well as GML (Global Marketing Lead) and teams with insightful, logical/scientific and emotional viewpoints.
It is required to proactively commit to entire project leadership in oncology BU and Amgen KK through cross-functional communications beyond its position and job frame.

Win
What we expect of you:

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s Degree and 5 years of directly related experience in marketing, ideally in Lung Cancer in a global pharmaceutical or biotech company OR

- Master’s degree and 4 years of directly related experience in marketing, ideally in Lung Cancer in a global pharmaceutical or biotech company

- Excellent English and Japanese communication skills in oral and written

- Excellent people manager and developer

- Excellent computer skills in Microsoft Office, all remote working tools

- Excellent time management and prioritization skills

- Strong Interpersonal skills and a team player

- Self-starter who can function autonomously

- Focus on deliverables within agreed upon deadlines

- Ability to pay close attention to detail and manage multiple tasks simultaneously

- Innovative, creative, flexible

Interpersonal skills and competencies:
- Strong communication and exceptional interpersonal and storytelling skills.

- Analytical skills and strategic thinking

- Strong at problem solving skills and good data sense

- Ability to build strong working relationships with internal and external customers

- Ability to manage ambiguity and keep direction

- Proven ability to enact change quickly

- Team player with ability to work closely with cross functional departments in planning, monitoring, and implementing strategic business plans

- Ability to develop a network of opinions leaders

- Role model for Amgen’s Values

Thrive
What you can expect of us:
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, so we work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being.
- Vast opportunities to learn and move up and across our global organization

- Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where teammates are empowered to bring ideas to the table and act

jobs.description:
Career Category

Job Description
Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients
At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission - to serve patients living with serious illnesses - drives all that we do.
Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas - Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease - we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
What you will do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, the Senior Manager, Incentive Compensation Administration Lead will provide senior leadership for the accurate, timely, compliant, and scalable administration of field incentive compensation programs. The role will lead delivery across internal and external teams in AIN and India, while managing relationships across a complex set of internal teams and functional groups.
This is a high-impact role responsible for end-to-end IC administration and operations, including cycle delivery, data and calculation controls, payment readiness, governance, platform operations, and continuous improvement. The role will serve as a trusted operational partner to Amgen’s U.S. Commercial organization.
Responsibilities
- Key Integrator: Act as the main point of contact and representative in India for the Incentive Compensation Administration team.
- Talent Development: Train, develop, and manage talent to meet organizational needs.
- Incentive Compensation Administration and Operational Leadership - Lead the accurate, timely, and compliant administration of approved IC plans and compensation cycles, ensuring plan rules, governance requirements, internal controls, and business timelines are consistently met.
- Oversee end-to-end operational delivery across data intake, eligibility validation, crediting, calculation review, payment-file preparation, payout coordination, reconciliations, exception management, reporting, and post-payment validation.
- Monitor operational performance, payout trends, processing timelines, data-quality issues, field inquiries, and potential outliers; escalate material risks and drive appropriate corrective actions with stakeholders.

- Operational Excellence, Governance, and Delivery: - Lead end-to-end IC program operations, ensuring quality, scalability, and operational efficiency while establishing clear delivery priorities, service levels, quality controls, and accountability across the team and vendor partners.
- Establish and enforce governance standards by ensuring robust documentation practices, traceable audit trails, and effective control mechanisms across incentive compensation operations.
- Lead operational management of the IC technology platform, partnering with IT, vendors, and IC stakeholders to support platform enhancements, integrations, testing, and effective implementation of approved changes.
- Serve as the senior subject matter expert for IC operational data and administration, providing guidance and actionable solutions for data-related challenges, calculation questions, and complex field inquiries.

- Automation, Technology, and Continuous Improvement: - Lead identification, prioritization, testing, and implementation of automation opportunities that strengthen IC administration, controls, accuracy, timeliness, and scalability.
- Support the evaluation and adoption of approved AI-enabled and digital solutions by providing IC administration domain expertise and validating operational readiness, controls, and outputs.

- Lead the identification and prioritization of process improvements across IC administration, documentation, reporting, data controls, and vendor ways of working.
- Stakeholder and Delivery Management: Partner with global stakeholders to clarify operational requirements, coordinate decisions and delivery milestones, resolve issues, communicate progress, and ensure IC administration delivers a reliable field experience.

What we expect of you
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
Basic Qualifications
- Master’s degree & 10+ years of experience in Incentive Compensation administration and operations.
- Bachelor’s degree & 12+ years of experience in Incentive Compensation administration and operations.
- 3+ years of leadership experience directly managing people, teams, projects, programs, and directing the allocation of resources.

Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant sales force effectiveness, sales operations, and field platforms and systems (i.e. CRM, sales operations enablement, reporting) in the bio/pharmaceutical industry and/or consulting experience.
- Analytical Skills : The ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions is crucial. This includes proficiency in statistical analysis and familiarity with tools like Excel, SQL, and data visualization software.
- Technical Proficiency : Knowledge of relevant software and technologies, such as sales planning and operations platforms (targeting, alignment and roster management, incentive compensation), sales CRM, and other field-specific tools, is important.
- Critical Thinking: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to diagnose complex IC operational issues, assess risk, and implement practical, compliant solutions.
- Project Management: Ability to lead cross-functional teams to manage IC administration initiatives, platform enhancements, annual cycles, and process improvements.
- Collaboration:  Ability to work effectively with stakeholders to ensure alignment and support for initiatives
- Communication:  Effective communication is key, both in writing and verbally. This includes the ability to present data and findings clearly to stakeholders and team members.
- Oral, written and presentation skills to explain complex concepts and controversial findings clearly to a variety of audiences, including senior management
- Comfortable challenging the status quo and bringing forward innovative solutions
- Ability to identify areas for process and systems innovation and implement change that will enhance the overall effectiveness of the team

What you will do
In this vital role, the Director, Global Diagnostic Strategy Lead (DxSL) will lead the creation, alignment, and execution of comprehensive global diagnostic strategies for assigned molecules and programs within a disease area or therapeutic area. The DxSL serves as the primary diagnostic strategy point of contact for program teams and governance forums, helping ensure that diagnostic development plans enable clinical development, regulatory approval, launch, commercialization, and lifecycle management of precision therapeutics.
The Diagnostics (Dx) Group is responsible for the successful transition of biomarker assays into marketed diagnostics that support therapeutic development strategy, regulatory approval, access, and commercialization.
You will:
- Develop and lead integrated, end-to-end diagnostic strategies from early diagnostic need assessment through launch and lifecycle management.
- Partner with Product Teams, program leadership and other decision-making forums, to align therapeutic and diagnostic development objectives.
- Evaluate and propose diagnostic strategic options, including assay and platform approaches, partner strategy, regulatory and commercial pathways, trade-offs, opportunities, costs, timelines, and risks.
- Lead and oversee Dx Development Teams (DxDTs) to ensure tactical execution of the diagnostic development plan and alignment between Rx and Dx development programs.
- Influence decision-making in a matrixed environment by communicating balanced, unbiased assessments of diagnostic opportunities and risks.
- Represent the Dx function with internal stakeholders and external diagnostic development partners.
- Manage, coach, and develop a small team of Dx technical leads, as applicable, while delivering through cross-functional leadership and influence.

Key Responsibilities
Diagnostic strategy and portfolio leadership
- Assess the need for diagnostic development for each assigned molecule or program within the disease area or therapeutic area portfolio.
- Work with cross-functional Dx subject matter experts and program functional leads to build comprehensive, global, long-term diagnostic strategies that support program objectives.
- Document and communicate diagnostic strategy through appropriate templates, decision materials, and executive-ready slide decks.
- Provide strategic input to program teams and governance forums to enable informed decisions on diagnostic development options.

Execution through Dx Development Teams
- Oversee DxDTs to ensure delivery of diagnostic development plans, milestones, timelines, risks, mitigations, and interdependencies.
- Partner with Project Management to track risks, mitigations, milestones, timelines, resources, and financials across diagnostic development activities.
- Ensure diagnostic strategies and plans are integrated with therapeutic development plans and clinical trial execution needs.
- Operate within Amgen governance, policy, and decision-making frameworks, including DAI where applicable.

External partner strategy and business planning
- Work across Amgen functions to identify, evaluate, and select diagnostic development partners as needed.
- Oversee partner-selection activities related to diagnostic development, including workplan development and alignment on scope, roles, and deliverables.
- Lead collaboration with external diagnostic partners to integrate diagnostic development, approval, and launch strategies.

Global launch, commercialization, and lifecycle management
- Ensure diagnostic strategies incorporate global clinical, regulatory, commercial, access, and regional execution requirements.
- Partner with global and regional commercial teams to align on commercial diagnostic strategy, including regional or country gap assessments.
- Lead lifecycle management planning for diagnostic platforms or assays to support program objectives after initial approval and launch.
- Support diagnostic market landscape assessments and business case development for key strategic choices.

Matrix leadership and stakeholder engagement
- Communicate effectively with Amgen leadership, therapeutic product teams, cross-functional collaborators, and external partners.
- Lead with courage and influence without direct authority across a complex matrix environment.
- Proactively provide balanced and thoughtful input to product teams and other work package teams.
- Actively seek and incorporate input from Dx Regulatory, Drug Regulatory, Clinical, Medical, Commercial, Value and Access, Business Development, Alliance Management, and other stakeholders.

- Comprehensive diagnostic development strategies for assigned drug development programs and portfolio priorities.
- Documented Dx strategy materials, including strategy templates, decision documents, and slide decks for cross-functional alignment and governance discussions.

- Global and regional diagnostic launch, commercialization, and lifecycle management plans.

- Direct experience developing and implementing diagnostic, companion diagnostic, or precision medicine strategies within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or diagnostics setting.
- Advanced degree in biomedical sciences, medicine, diagnostics, molecular biology, pathology, genomics, oncology, or related discipline (Ph.D., M.D., Pharm.D., or equivalent).

jobs.description:
Career Category
Supply Chain
Job Description
Manager, Business Performance - Amgen External Planning
Role Summary
The Manager, Business Performance drives strategic improvements to AXP processes and ways of working, while delivering data-driven insights across the organization. The role helps shape AXP's digital strategy and enables smarter planning and supply chains across internal and external manufacturing through analytics, AI, and technology.
The Manager owns improvements to the AXP Process Framework across Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, and Enable. In partnership with the Business Delivery Office (BDO) and Amgen Digital and Technology teams, the role standardizes workflows, identifies process gaps, and advances digital transformation.
The role works with Global, Regional, and Site Supply Chain teams, Global Distribution, Contract Quality Management, Operations Finance, Global Planning, and AXP Regional Hubs. It supports performance visibility across commercial and pre-commercial supply, integrated business planning, operational excellence, digital adoption, and compliance.
Roles and Responsibilities
Improve and Govern AXP Processes
·   Own and improve the AXP Process Framework across Plan, Source, Make, Deliver, and Enable.
·   Standardize end-to-end workflows, roles, and handoffs across functions, regions, and sites.
·   Identify process gaps, risks, duplication, and unclear handoffs; maintain process maps, RACI matrices, work instructions, job aids, and guidance documents.
·   Work with AXP Compliance and the BDO to manage changes to SOPs and approved documents.
·   Apply Lean Business Systems and Operational Excellence methods to improve processes and ways of working.
Lead Continuous Improvement and Automation
·   Use process analysis and value stream mapping to identify and prioritize continuous improvement, automation, and quick-win projects.
·   Develop business justifications that define expected benefits, ROI, cost avoidance, and cost savings.
·   Track project outcomes and confirm whether expected benefits are achieved.
Advance Digital Transformation and Smart Supply Chains
·   Help shape and deliver AXP's digital strategy and transformation initiatives.
·   Identify practical uses of data, analytics, AI, and automation to improve internal and external manufacturing, planning, and supply chain processes.
·   Partner with Amgen Digital and Technology teams to define business needs and develop scalable solutions.
·   Translate business needs into system and reporting requirements; support implementation, adoption, and ongoing monitoring of solutions.
Monitor Business and Financial Performance
·   Track AXP Supply Chain and Finance metrics with Operations Finance and Global Planning.
·   Maintain and improve KPI dashboards, reporting tools, and metric definitions; analyze performance across commercial and pre-commercial supply.
·   Identify important trends, variances, risks, and KPIs requiring immediate attention; share insights and coordinate follow-up actions with the appropriate owners.
·   Support visibility of agreed measures, including cost to serve, productivity, capacity, inventory, logistics, and financial plan or forecast variances.
·   Support Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), Integrated Business Planning (IBP), and forward 12-quarter strategy discussions.
·   Present data and analysis clearly to support business decisions.
Partner Across AXP and Global Functions
·   Align priorities with the AXP Supply Execution Manager and BDO Manager.
·   Partner with Global, Regional, and Site Supply Chain teams, Global Distribution, Contract Quality Management, Operations Finance, Global Planning, and AXP Regional Hubs.
·   Support integrated processes and systems across regions and functions, working effectively across the US, Europe, and JAPAC time zones.
Lead Projects and Develop Team Capability
·   Lead cross-functional projects and manage multiple priorities with minimal direction.
·   Advise leaders on options, risks, and solutions for complex issues.
·   Coach and develop team members; support capability building, succession planning, and engagement.
·   Promote accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Tools and Systems
Familiarity with modern supply chain and business performance tools is preferred:
·   Supply chain and enterprise planning: SAP S/4HANA, Kinaxis RapidResponse, or other enterprise planning systems.
·   Process mapping: iGrafx, Microsoft Visio, or Lucidchart.
·   Analytics and reporting: Tableau or similar business intelligence tools.
·   Process management: process monitoring, process governance, and controlled documentation.
Basic Qualifications
Candidates must meet one of the following education and experience requirements:
·   Doctorate degree and at least 3 years of Supply Chain, Business Analytics, or Operations experience; or
·   Master's degree and at least 8 years of relevant experience; or
·   Bachelor's degree and at least 10 years of relevant experience.
In addition, candidates must have at least 2 years of experience directly managing or leading projects or programs.
Preferred Qualifications
·   Experience leading cross-functional process standardization or improvement initiatives.
·   Lean Six Sigma experience; Green Belt certification preferred.
·   Strong analytical mindset and experience using data to identify business opportunities.
·   Experience applying analytics, AI, or automation to supply chain processes.
·   Ability to identify quick wins and develop business justifications, including ROI, cost avoidance, and cost savings.
·   Experience in pharmaceutical or biotech supply chains and GMP-regulated environments.
·   Understanding of internal and external manufacturing, including CMO/CDMO operations.
·   Experience with KPI dashboards, performance reporting, or KPI governance.
·   Experience supporting QBRs, IBP, or Long-Range Strategy cycles.
·   Strong project management, communication, presentation, and financial skills, including cost to serve, productivity, and capacity.
Soft Skills
·   Growth mindset and willingness to learn, adapt, and improve.
·   Uses sound judgment and is willing to take calculated risks to move work forward.
·   Flexible and effective when collaborating across global time zones.
·   Seeks feedback, reflects on it, and applies it to improve performance.
·   Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
·   Constructive, accountable, and patient-focused attitude.

This is an India-based global role supporting Amgen's global obesity business. The Senior Manager, Analytics Products & Technology will own the development and evolution of business-facing products that enable leaders to move from insight to action with clarity and speed.
It is a product leadership role at its core - requiring strong judgment, technical fluency, and a deep understanding of how leaders make decisions. The focus is on creating products that simplify complexity, accelerate decisions, and meaningfully improve how the organization operates.
This leader's mandate is to build products that serve as critical enablers of how the business plans, prioritizes, and executes. This leader will shape their direction, ensure they evolve with the needs of the organization, and drive adoption in a way that makes them indispensable to everyday work.
The role also plays a key part in advancing AI-enabled capabilities and intelligent automation across the organization. As new opportunities emerge, this leader will help bring them to life in a way that is practical, scalable, and grounded in real business impact - ensuring that innovation translates into meaningful change, not experimentation for its own sake.
Success is measured by products that become part of how the business runs—trusted, widely adopted, and consistently making work faster, simpler, and more effective.
Key Responsibilities
1. Product Strategy, Roadmap & Technology Prioritization
- Own the product roadmap for Gateway, SKU Solver, and related decision-support capabilities, ensuring each product solves a real business problem and earns a place in everyday work.
- Shape user journeys, requirements, backlogs, release plans, value measures, and success criteria that connect product work to business decisions.
- Prioritize with discipline, balancing user value, technical feasibility, adoption potential, speed, risk, and long-term maintainability.
- Bring structure to ambiguity so teams understand what is being built, why it matters, and how it will change the way the organization plans, prioritizes, or executes.

2. Product Discovery, Design & User Experience
- Work closely with leaders, analytics teams, and end users to understand how decisions are made today and where products can remove friction.
- Turn complex workflows into simple product concepts, intuitive experiences, and practical solution designs that help users move from insight to action.
- Challenge requests that add complexity without value, and redirect teams toward solutions that are useful, scalable, and easy to adopt.
- Partner with design, engineering, data, analytics, and business teams to test assumptions early and refine solutions before significant build effort is committed.
- Keep the user experience central. The best product is not the one with the most features; it is the one people trust and use.
